info.name: Caiyun Weather Air Quality Precipitation Map API
Caiyun Weather Get Precipitation Map Tile

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Optional Unix epoch second for the nowcast frame. Omit to receive the most recent observation; provide a future timestamp within the nowcast horizon to render a forecast frame.

items.docs: Returns a 256x256 PNG raster tile representing radar + nowcast precipitation intensity colored by the standard dBZ palette. Suitable for overlaying on Web Mercator base maps (Mapbox, MapLibre, OpenLayers, Leaflet) to render live precipitation animations.
